Keeping your place when everything around you is changing

A collection of notes about continuity, repeated action and the moments between states.

Save collection
Kept in this browser
Notes on this collection

This collection brings together observations, references and unresolved questions from our ongoing research. It is intended for close reading and return visits rather than a linear presentation.

Look for the relationships between attention, scale and context. A useful detail becomes more valuable when it survives changes in content, screen size and the way a person moves through the work.

The working notes remain provisional. Revisit the evidence, compare different contexts and keep the next useful question close to the material.
